patternDistribution.rule: No structural pattern should dominate a production batch.

divisorDistribution.rule: Approved divisors should rotate across batches.

targetRemainderDistribution.rule: Target remainders should rotate within each divisor; remainder 0 should not dominate.

questionLanguageDistribution.rule: After human wording is supplied, no stem slot should dominate.

explanationDistribution.rule: After human explanations are supplied, no explanation slot should dominate.
